usage: lightdock3 [-h] [-f configuration_file] [-s SCORING_FUNCTION]
                  [-sg GSO_SEED] [-t TRANSLATION_STEP] [-r ROTATION_STEP] [-V]
                  [-c CORES] [--profile] [-mpi] [-ns NMODES_STEP] [-min]
                  [--listscoring] [-l SWARM_LIST [SWARM_LIST ...]]
                  setup_file steps

positional arguments:
  setup_file            Setup file name
  steps                 number of steps of the simulation

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -f configuration_file, --file configuration_file
                        algorithm configuration file
  -s SCORING_FUNCTION, --scoring_function SCORING_FUNCTION
                        scoring function used
  -sg GSO_SEED, --seed GSO_SEED
                        seed used in the algorithm
  -t TRANSLATION_STEP, --translation_step TRANSLATION_STEP
                        translation step
  -r ROTATION_STEP, --rotation_step ROTATION_STEP
                        normalized rotation step
  -V, -v, --version     show version
  -c CORES, --cores CORES
                        number of cpu cores to use
  --profile             Output profiling data
  -mpi, --mpi           activates the MPI parallel execution
  -ns NMODES_STEP, --nmodes_step NMODES_STEP
                        normalized normal modes step
  -min, --min           activates the local minimization
  --listscoring         list all available scoring functions
  -l SWARM_LIST [SWARM_LIST ...], --list SWARM_LIST [SWARM_LIST ...]
                        List of swarms to simulate
